summaryZh: 将人物动作压缩成小幅蜡笔图形，用断续干涩轮廓和少量粉彩暗示衣着，在纸面上保留充足留白。
summaryEn: A small crayon gesture drawing on a broad warm paper field, defined by broken powdery contours and sparse pastel marks. Reduce the observed figure to a compact off-center drawing occupying about one third of the frame height.
sampleTitleZh: 蜡笔留白小像独立参考照片
sampleTitleEn: Tiny Crayon Gesture Stamp independent source photograph
samplePrompt: A realistic full-body photograph of one fictional adult with a short auburn bob, dusty-blue jacket, ochre skirt and white shoes, leaning forward slightly to hold a small cream watering can with both hands. Plain pale beige studio background. One vertical 4:5 photorealistic photograph, entire subject comfortably framed, 1024x1280 minimum. Independently generated fictional source; no borrowed reference, text, logo or watermark.
sampleAnalysis: Pending actual source-image inspection; replace with verified observations before approval.
mediumAnchor: A small crayon gesture drawing on a broad warm paper field, defined by broken powdery contours and sparse pastel marks.

fragments.text: A small crayon gesture drawing on a broad warm paper field, defined by broken powdery contours and sparse pastel marks.
Reduce the observed figure to a compact off-center drawing occupying about one third of the frame height.
Use blunt grainy crayon edges, interrupted contours and a few translucent rubbed patches rather than complete tonal modeling.
Keep three subdued colors from the source clothing, allowing most paper to remain untouched.
Prioritize the distinctive pose, hair outline and held object; omit incidental background details without adding symbols.
Deliver one finished image at the input aspect ratio, without comparison panels, unrequested lettering, logos, signatures or watermarks.

preserve: Simplify the observed figure and reduce its scale within the canvas; retain connected gesture, identity cues and meaningful object contacts.
Preserve observed subject count, recognizable features, clothing colors, meaningful objects and their physical relationships.
Keep the complete main subject and essential connections legible; never infer absent details from the example description.
negative: Duplicate subjects, disconnected anatomy, accidental cropping or invented accessories.
Full-frame dense painting, sticker borders, background doodle clutter, thick smooth marker ink or before-after panels.
Unrequested lettering, logos, signatures, watermarks or comparison panels.
